map_info.name: Vectors_Act3_FieldsAndMotion
map_info.title: The room gives a direction
map_info.description: Give the known PointBody a position-dependent acceleration with inward and tangential components. Solid cylinder arrows make the field legible; eighteen spheres, cubes and cylinders supply receivers. Walk into it and feel the same acceleration through the existing player movement adapter. Reconstruct the field sample and its receiver, then change the balance without prescribing a path.

learning_objectives: Sample a field; retain a moving state

documentation.layout: One primary encounter, spaced comparisons, a clear perimeter route. See the curation manifest for lesson roles.
